name: std::unique_ptr<T,Deleter>::operator<<
intro:
Inserts the value of the pointer managed by p into the output stream os.

Equivalent to os << p.get().

This overload participates in overload resolution only if os << p.get() is a valid expression.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
os

 -

 a std::basic_ostream to insert p into


 p

 -

 the pointer to be inserted into os

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: If std::unique_ptr<Y, D>::pointer is a pointer to a character type (e.g., when Y is char([]) or CharT([])), this may end up calling the overloads of operator<< for null-terminated character strings (causing undefined behavior if the pointer does not in fact point to such a string), rather than the overload for printing the value of the pointer itself.

summary: Inserts the value of the pointer managed by p into the output stream os.
